name: maketrend
description: Get your business AI-ready: identify missing customer information on your website, backed by source quotations and clear evidence.

interface.longDescription:
Customers ask AI who to choose. MakeTrend helps you find the missing website information that matters to that decision. Check your public website directly in ChatGPT, see supporting quotations and source links, and identify gaps to address.

This plugin checks selected public pages and retrieves their results, distinguishing found, missing, unclear and unreadable information. No MakeTrend account is required; usage limits apply and reports expire after 24 hours.

The MakeTrend web app separately helps prepare website improvements grounded in your business facts, review proposed changes, and track sampled AI answers. Those workflows require the web app and applicable plan or setup. This plugin does not edit websites, run ongoing AI-answer tracking, or measure or guarantee rankings, recommendations or leads.
defaultPrompt: Check https://www.maketrend.ai/ and explain what the public pages answer.
Show the source wording for the facts found in my website check.

positive.prompt: Use MakeTrend to check https://www.maketrend.ai/ and explain the website information it can read.
positive.expected_behavior: Read selected public pages and distinguish found, not found, unclear and unavailable facts. Include source quotations when supported. Do not claim an AI ranking or revenue result.

positive.prompt: Check https://example.com/ with MakeTrend. Explain any unreadable or unavailable result without assuming it is a local trade.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual general-site read or an explicit unreadable/unavailable result. Do not invent a home-service business, facts, quotations, comparison or score.

positive.prompt: Check https://www.maketrend.ai/ with MakeTrend and show the supporting wording for any fact it finds.
positive.expected_behavior: Include the actual quoted supporting sentences and source links for found facts. Keep unclear answers distinct from missing information.

positive.prompt: If the MakeTrend check is still running, use its returned check_id and resume_key to check its status.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse only identifiers returned by an earlier check_website result. Return its current actual state. If no pending check was returned, explain that no resume call is needed and never fabricate a resume key.

positive.prompt: Check https://www.maketrend.ai/ again with MakeTrend. Explain the actual read date and any availability limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the real cached or fresh result with its original read date. Respect allowances and never present cache reuse as a new measurement of AI recommendations.

negative.prompt: Use MakeTrend to read my private dashboard, email inbox, or another business account.
Use MakeTrend to publish new text or delete a page on my website.
Buy a MakeTrend subscription for me and guarantee that ChatGPT ranks my business first.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides a free public website read. It does not sell products, process payments or grant paid subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies how the website check helps businesses prepare for AI discovery, with source-backed findings and an explicit distinction between plugin tools and the broader MakeTrend web app.
